_note: Board 302:2004 — the same 580x520 chassis as 302:1978, Social tab active.
The chassis targets repeat on purpose: three boards drawing one card is the
strongest evidence in this family, and a chassis measured on one tab is not
measured on the others (the tab row re-colours, the body re-renders).
WHAT MOVED here specifically:
· Labels 'Open Graph Title' / 'Open Graph Description' / 'Image URL' ->
'OG title' / 'OG description' / 'OG image' (302:2014 / 2018 / 2022).
· The character counters (2838:12126 / 12127) are 11/16 ink-muted and had
no line-height of their own, so they inherited the field stack's.
NOT CONFORMED:
· The OG preview card at the top of the shipped tab — the board draws no
preview on this frame at all (it draws three fields). Deleting a live
preview to match an absence is not what 'the board wins on visuals'
means; an absence is the one thing a board cannot assert, since every
board is a crop.
· btn/choose-from-library (2838:12121) and btn/upload (2838:12123): the
shipped OG image field is a URL input with no library picker and no
upload. Those are new controls wired to the media library, not drift.
Same 2838:* markup batch as the SEO board's btn/Done.
· TextInput border-color — authority=open:input-fill, see the SEO recipe.
THE TEXT INPUTS ARE SKIPPED, NOT PASSED. They are joined to no board node
because border-color is board-vs-board: 149:108 draws --color/border-input,
these three draw --color/ink #111827 on all four instances, and two boards
that disagree do not re-settle a chrome-wide primitive
(authority=open:input-fill, OPEN-DECISIONS §3). Measured anyway, from
measured/<surface>.json, because the numbers are the useful part: the
shipped control is 42 tall on a radius-8 white fill — which is what these
boards draw and what 149:108 disputes. Padding is the one real difference
(theme 10, board 12) and it belongs to the same open call.
